terms.title: Agent
terms.description: A model-backed reviewer produced the observation.

terms.title: Deterministic sensor
terms.description: A non-model analyzer or scanner produced the observation.

terms.title: Human
terms.description: A person produced the observation.

terms.title: Imported
terms.description: The observation was migrated from a legacy contract without a directly observed producer.

terms.title: Unknown
terms.description: Absence never means agent; the producer could not be determined.

terms.title: Available
terms.description: The evidence needed for the assessment was collected.

terms.title: Partial
terms.description: Some but not all required evidence was collected.

terms.title: Unavailable
terms.description: No evidence was collected. Describes coverage only; it is not a pass or block.

terms.title: Pass
terms.description: The evidence establishes conformance for the review or aspect.

terms.title: Concern
terms.description: The evidence raises a qualified concern short of failure.

terms.title: Fail
terms.description: The evidence establishes non-conformance for the review or aspect.

terms.title: Inconclusive
terms.description: The evidence does not establish an outcome.

terms.title: Not applicable
terms.description: The aspect does not apply to the subject.

terms.title: Not assessed
terms.description: The aspect was not evaluated.

terms.title: Improved
terms.description: Used only for before/after comparisons: the change made the aspect better.

terms.title: Regressed
terms.description: Used only for before/after comparisons: the change made the aspect worse.

terms.title: Mixed
terms.description: Used only for before/after comparisons: the change improved some aspects and regressed others.

terms.title: Unchanged
terms.description: Used only for before/after comparisons: the change had no observed effect.

terms.title: No observed delta
terms.description: Used only for before/after comparisons: no delta was observed for the aspect.

terms.title: Inconclusive
terms.description: Used only for before/after comparisons: the comparison could not establish a direction.

terms.title: Allow
terms.description: Optional policy output with a required policyRef; never supplied by a raw finding.

terms.title: Warn
terms.description: Optional policy output with a required policyRef; never supplied by a raw finding.

terms.title: Block
terms.description: Optional policy output with a required policyRef; never supplied by a raw finding.

terms.title: Defer
terms.description: Optional policy output with a required policyRef; never supplied by a raw finding.

terms.title: Critical
terms.description: Retains current ordering and meaning; scoring weights stay in policy.

terms.title: High
terms.description: Retains current ordering and meaning; scoring weights stay in policy.

terms.title: Medium
terms.description: Retains current ordering and meaning; scoring weights stay in policy.

terms.title: Low
terms.description: Retains current ordering and meaning; scoring weights stay in policy.

terms.title: Info
terms.description: Retains current ordering and meaning; scoring weights stay in policy.

terms.title: Open
terms.description: Lives in lifecycle events, not observations.

terms.title: Accepted risk
terms.description: The explicit successor of the legacy 'accepted' spelling.

terms.title: Waived
terms.description: Lives in lifecycle events, not observations.

terms.title: False positive
terms.description: Lives in lifecycle events, not observations.

terms.title: Resolved
terms.description: Lives in lifecycle events, not observations. Requires an explicit or policy-backed resolution event.
